items.title: Alex Saffy takes the bronze in the 2024 Paralympic Games
items.excerpt: SIDE graduate Alex Saffy, the ‘Bunbury Bullet’, secured bronze in the Men’s 100m butterfly S10 in Paris.
article: Dubbed by fans and friends as the ‘Bunbury Bullet’, SIDE graduate Alex Saffy secured the bronze medal in the Men’s 100m butterfly S10 at the 2024 Paralympic Games in Paris, delivering a performance that also established a new Oceania record.
Competing against an international field, his race reflected years of structured training, technical refinement, and competitive consistency at the highest level of para-swimming.

As part of SIDE’s Elite Performance Program, Alex was able to prioritise his demanding training schedule while continuing his academic studies in parallel. The program’s flexible delivery allowed him to balance national and international competition commitments with coursework, ultimately enabling him to complete and achieve his WACE certification alongside his sporting career.

items.title: Dancers following their dreams
items.excerpt: The Community Arts Program supports aspiring dancers to train and perform while completing secondary school.
article: The SCSA-endorsed Community Arts Program at SIDE supports aspiring dancers in developing their artistic practice while continuing to engage in a structured and recognised secondary education pathway. Students are able to commit to regular training, rehearsals, and performance opportunities without compromising their academic responsibilities.

Through a balance of creative exploration and disciplined technique, the program prepares students for the practical demands of the performing arts industry. Participants build foundational skills in collaboration, self-management, and performance readiness, equipping them to progress toward further training or professional pathways in dance and related creative fields.
